from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak

class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for custom muon preselection"""
    
    def process_object_preselection(self, df):
        """Build MuonGood collection: muons with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = df["Muon"]
        df["MuonGood"] = muons[(muons.pt > 15) & (abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)]
        return df
    
    def process_object_counting(self, df):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        df["n_muons_selected"] = ak.num(df["MuonGood"])
        return df

if __name__ == "__main__":
    processor = DimuonAnalysis()
